messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected on prod-gateway (edge-proxy) — 5xx handshake failures increasing from 0.2% -> 12% in last 5m. Pager sent to #incidents and @sara.k (primary oncall).

oncall-bot: Alert details: metric=frontend.handshake_5xx rate=0.12 threshold=0.01 region=us-west-2 affected_routes=[/v1/generate, /v1/chat] links: https://metrics.internal/r/abc123

sara.k: I’m on it. Paging SRE rotation. @matt.sre can you join?

matt.sre: joining — seeing spike, logs show TLS handshake errors: "tls: handshake failure" and "ssl_read: unexpected EOF" from edge proxies to upstream runtime pools. Reproducing with curl shows TLS alert handshake_failure.

anna.cs: any customer-facing impact? Customer Success seeing increased support tickets citing 502s. Queues: two enterprise customers report timeouts on inference calls.

john.eng: grabbing proxy logs. early hypothesis: cert chain mismatch or expired intermediate. There were cert rotations scheduled earlier today.

matt.sre: quick check: openssl s_client -connect gateway-usw2:443 -servername gateway.redwood.ai | sed -n '1,50p'
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
139909... error:14077410:SSL routines:SSL23_GET_SERVER_HELLO:sslv3 alert handshake failure
---
No client certificate CA names sent
---
```

sara.k: deploy-bot — any rotation jobs or deploys around 12:40?

deploy-bot: Notified: cert-rotator job attempted at 12:42UTC -> job status: FAILED (timeout during upload to edge-proxy group A). Rollback: none. Job retried once at 12:55UTC -> SUCCESS for pool B only.

matt.sre: that matches. pool A still serving the old cert but apparently its chain missing intermediate -> negotiation fails for some clients that require fullchain. pool B has new cert+fullchain and healthy. Traffic split: ~60% to pool A currently.

john.eng: checking cert details from pool A:
```
openssl x509 -in /etc/edge/certs/leaf.crt -noout -text | grep -E "Not After|Issuer"
Not After : Mar 10 12:38:00 2026 GMT
Issuer: CN=InterCA Ltd
```

john.eng: leaf expired 5 days ago. Rotator should have replaced it but upload timeout left pool A with expired leaf and missing chain.

anna.cs: confirmed impacted customers are on routes that still hit pool A due to hashed routing. Reaching out to CSMs with mitigation ETA.

sara.k: Triage plan: 1) Fail traffic away from pool A -> route 100% to pool B (healthy) 2) If routing change not possible, swap in fallback cert (secondary) on pool A 3) Restart proxies on pool A in controlled fashion.

matt.sre: I'll implement traffic shift via smart-routing flag. Pushing change now: //ops/k8s/ingress-config: set routing.priority.poolA=0

matt.sre: patch applied. Observability: sent update to metrics dashboard.

deploy-bot: routing change deployed to control plane at 13:03UTC.

matt.sre: seeing error rate drop from 12% -> 1.1% over 90s. Latency normalizing. Rolling back to 0.4% after 5m.

anna.cs: sending customer comms: "We are seeing a TLS certificate issue impacting a subset of requests. We are routing traffic to healthy hosts; mitigation in progress. Will update in 30m."

sara.k: next: remediate pool A long-term: either finish rotator upload or apply fallback cert. Which is faster?

john.eng: fallback cert available in secret store (edge-fallback/fullchain.pem). I can apply it to pool A nodes but need to coordinate restarts. Applying cert + reload should be <8m for canary nodes.

matt.sre: do canary first: pick 2 nodes, apply cert, reload proxy, verify. If OK, roll remainder.

sara.k: do it. Announce pages to avoid double restarts.

john.eng: starting canary on pool A node-a1 (13:12UTC). Steps: 1) kubectl cp secret -> /etc/edge/certs/ 2) nginx -s reload (proxy) or systemctl reload edge-proxy.

john.eng: canary reload logs:
```
[13:13:05] INFO loaded cert /etc/edge/certs/edge-fallback/fullchain.pem
[13:13:07] INFO proxy reload ok
[13:13:10] INFO handshake errors on node-a1 -> 0
```

matt.sre: canary looks good. Rolling rest of pool A nodes in 2m batches.

ops_rotation: rolling updates started (13:16UTC). Stagger 2 nodes at a time, 30s drain, reload, healthcheck.

matt.sre: monitoring aggregate errors. Progress: pool A nodes updated: 2/8 -> errors continuing to drop.

anna.cs: customers updated: "Mitigation applied, traffic routed to healthy hosts while we replace expired certificate on affected nodes. No further customer action required."

sara.k: Are there any dependencies to KMS keys or IAM causing rotator upload timeouts? Need root cause follow-up.

john.eng: preliminary: rotator upload timed out due to a transient S3 endpoint error in us-west-2 + the rotator lacked a retry/backoff. File uploaded to bucket but callback to control plane timed out. Coordinator marked job as FAILED causing partial rollout. We'll open an issue in rotator service.

matt.sre: once pool A fully healthy, I'll switch routing back and close pager. ETA 15-20m for full completion.

matt.sre: pool A update complete (13:28UTC). Aggregate 5xx handshake errors <0.2%. Traffic slowly switched back to normal.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT SEV=2 created: incident_id=INC-2026-033-47. Impact: elevated 5xx and timeouts for subset of customers for ~46m. RCA: expired leaf cert + partial rotator failure.

anna.cs: logging a customer impact summary and sending targeted follow-ups to affected enterprise accounts.

sara.k: action items (assigned):
- john.eng: create rotator bug ticket (ROT-342) with logs, S3 trace, and recommend retry/backoff + alert on partial rollout (due EOD).
- matt.sre: run post-incident checklist, gather histogram of error rates and rollback windows (due EOD).
- ops_rotation: add healthcheck gate to rotation job to detect stale certs (due next sprint).
- anna.cs: finalize customer comms and a support playbook for similar incidents (due tomorrow).

john.eng: ticket ROT-342 created: https://issues.internal/ROT-342 — includes upload trace, failed callback logs, and suggested fix.

matt.sre: closing pager in 45m if no regrowth. Will hand off final writeup to incident response doc.

anna.cs: thx all. Good coordination. :thumbsup:

sara.k: closing updates: final metrics snapshot attached to incident: peak errors 12%, duration ~46m, affected traffic 18% of prod-gateway, mitigated by traffic reroute + fallback cert. Postmortem owner: matt.sre.

matt.sre: will schedule RCA and postmortem. If anything reappears ping me directly.

matt.sre: closing thread — last check at 13:35UTC shows steady healthy.
